events.title: Scenario: Rapid AI-driven data-center demand increases localized transformer and substation stress
events.summary: AI-driven compute growth may concentrate load on specific substations, raising transformer and protection demand. Utilities may need near-term engineering and procurement workarounds if supply or lead times are constrained.

events.title: Scenario: Renewable generation variability increases local transmission congestion risk
events.summary: Higher renewable penetration may elevate transmission congestion frequency in constrained corridors, leading to more redispatch and potential curtailments during maintenance windows.

events.title: Scenario: Aging GIS components and retrofit pressures at urban substations
events.summary: Aging GIS assets in urban substations may drive hybrid retrofit strategies to reduce outage windows, increasing demand for modular secondary systems and spare parts.

events.title: Scenario: Transformer manufacturing constrained by critical-mineral and core-material availability
events.summary: Material constraints for transformer manufacturing could lengthen lead times and prompt shifts toward standardization, refurbishment, or local assembly to manage risk.

events.title: Scenario: EPCs adopt modular substation builds to shorten schedules amid supply uncertainty
events.summary: Modular substation adoption could accelerate to manage procurement and installation risk, favoring local assembly and shorter outage strategies.

events.title: Scenario: Battery storage and on-site resilience investments shift load profiles and grid-service opportunities
events.summary: BESS deployment at data centers could reshape peak profiles and create market opportunities for aggregated grid services, while increasing maintenance and lifecycle-service needs.

events.title: Scenario: Inverter firmware variability increases attention on firmware management and grid-interconnection testing
events.summary: Firmware diversity among inverters may force more rigorous firmware management and testing requirements to maintain grid stability as distributed energy grows.

events.title: Scenario: Permitting signals for lithium and other minerals could affect battery and transformer material flows
events.summary: Permitting and logistics dynamics for critical minerals may translate into tighter downstream supplies for batteries and some transformer materials, prompting substitution and recycling strategies.

events.title: Scenario: Capacity-market signals and procurement risk are influencing long-lead equipment planning
events.summary: Volatile capacity-market signals can materially alter procurement timing and specifications for long-lead items, raising contract-structure importance.

events.title: Scenario: Predictive-maintenance AI adoption increases OEM service and sensor-network demand
events.summary: AI-based predictive maintenance could reduce unexpected outages while increasing demand for sensors and OEM services, changing the balance between inventory and subscription spending.
